scenario: A hospital clinical pharmacist receives a patient's raw medication and lab data export, standardizes it with the clinical-data-cleaner, passes the cleaned medication list through the drug-interaction-checker to identify severity-ranked interactions, and then uses patiently-ai to produce a plain-language patient letter summarizing which medications were reviewed and any safety notes the patient should be aware of.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner standardizes raw patient medication data and produces a cleaned medication list CSV → drug-interaction-checker reads the medication list and produces a severity-ranked interaction report JSON → patiently-ai takes the interaction report and produces a plain-language patient-facing letter.
